subject: test: fix UBSan warning due to misaligned memory access in unit test_addRepliesWithOffloadsToList (#2201)
reason: The change edits only the unit test file src/unit/test_networking.c, replacing misaligned robj** dereferences with memcpy to fix a UBSan warning inside the tests themselves. No server source code, command behaviour, reply format, replication, persistence, or tool code changes, so no fuzzer scenario can reach or validate it; the fix is covered by the unit test suite itself.
